Episode 258. The Predator of All Dimensions (7)
Zzhaaaak-!
Kelliark's magic, which had been covering Malugia, was split in half. Through the gap, the sword aura of the Genesis Knights and Malugia's golden beams were fired.
His entire body was swept away. Kelliark once again manipulated the fact that he was hit, but unlike before, it wasn't perfect.
Most of the sword aura and sun energy disappeared upon contact with his body, but blood splattered. It was revealed that there was a limit to his manipulation.
However, he did not lose his composure. He had expected this much from the moment he had called out the recovering Malugia.
"Is this also according to your plan? Malugia, was it you who called me? Regrettably, it seems not. You're too weak compared to that day."
[Say whatever you wish. You won't be able to do so after the end.]
A golden spear embedded itself in Kelliark's shoulder. Malugia, about to continue with a follow-up attack, flinched for a moment and looked at the sky unfolding behind Kelliark.

Between the crushed, annihilated Realm of Reincarnation and the areas where she had been hiding, the light of regeneration left by Jin was twinkling. It was shining more broadly and intensely than ever before.
In some ways, Malugia found that light more bothersome than Kelliark. A light that seemed to say that this world fundamentally could not be erased.
"Where is your mind wandering, Malugia? The light of regeneration? Surely you're not bothered by something like this?"
[You covet this power too. While conquering so many dimensions, you have never encountered anything superior to this.]
"Ah, I suppose you could see it that way. But this light can't change anything right now. Focus on the fight. Otherwise, you'll get torn somewhere, like this."
Dark Origin magic, formed as sharp as a blade, sliced through Malugia's waist.

She hadn't prepared for it, having lost her focus for a moment on the light of regeneration. Even if she immediately regenerated the cut flesh and broken bone, her sun energy was bound to be extinguished by that much. It was only because Malugia was a transcendent being that it ended as just a wound.

"It is a sad thing for you, the ego of destruction, to associate with humans, especially one with the light of regeneration. Starting to get hurt like this already, can you even last an hour against me?"

In an hour, the completed Origin Stone would arrive on the battlefield. In contrast, the time the Coalition needed was seventeen times that, and even that was a calculation that didn't account for Jin operating within his sanctuary.
The situation was still desperate.
But Malugia smiled.
[Kelliark. Jin Runcandel gave you a proper piece of his mind. You can read the movements of a tiny creature tens of thousands of paces away, but you can never know the future.]
Kelliark's brow furrowed.
[But I am different... Though my vision is dim because I am not whole, I can know to some extent. The item you are waiting for will not arrive at that time.]
As soon as Malugia's words ended, a new golden dimensional gate formed behind Kelliark. From within, an immortal holding a sword like a warrior was appearing.
"...Kragos?"
Kragos, the ego of the Sun God who had pushed Dante to the brink of death and thrown the Empire into the abyss of ruin.

He had not been sealed nor annihilated on the battlefield that day. And right after the battle ended, he had entered the dimensional passage under Malugia's orders. Precisely to prevent the Origin Stone from arriving on time today.
[Your limbs were quite rough, Kelliark. They were accustomed to dealing with beings like me... It was almost dangerous.]
Shiik-! Kragos's sword grazed Kelliark's shoulder.
And in the brief moment he was deflecting Kragos's follow-up barrage, Kelliark recognized the traces of a magic he should not have been able to feel from him.
'Hister's magic, recording magic...!?'
Hister's magic remained on Kragos's body.
The meaning of that fact was clear. The rebel survivor, Valeria Hister, had helped Kragos.
'But this is strange. Did Valeria Hister shake off Silyn's pursuit and even help Kragos? Unless Silyn completely lost Valeria.'
Kelliark shook his head as his thoughts reached that point. The deed was done anyway, and those who had to pay the price were right in front of him.

"Kragos, you incompetent fool, you couldn't have navigated the dimensional passages alone. The egos of the Sun God, unable to realize even their own instincts without the help of mortals. How amusing. That is why you have always been blocked by me."
Tzzzzzzzt...! Kelliark's magic was connecting to the Demon Army's dimensional gates that were open all over the sky.
He was trying to confirm it. To see how much damage had been done to the path that was supposed to transport the completed Origin Stone.
The task was so agonizing that even Kelliark's body trembled and he let out a monstrous scream. He was clearly defenseless. The Coalition and the Sun God's egos fiercely rushed to strike him.

But approaching was not easy due to the shockwave generated as the magic and the dimensional gates connected. Five seconds. Just as the Genesis Knights who had first broken through the shock and entered range were about to swing their swords, Kelliark's eyes snapped open and he regained his senses.
"Yes... you've delayed it quite a bit, Malugia. I admit it, for the first time in a long while, my head is getting hot. Rage. A forgotten emotion."
Murderous intent filled Kelliark's eyes. Unlike his previous indifferent expression, his magic was also lashing out wildly and fiercely.
Soon, Kelliark grabbed the sword of Kragos, who was trying to create distance, with his hand. The blade shattered like glass, and Kragos threw a punch at Kelliark's face.
[You bastard!]
But the fist couldn't reach, being severed in front of Kelliark's eyes. A space explosion. The ultimate space explosion then sliced Kragos's entire body into dozens of pieces a moment later.
[Kuaaaaargh...!]
Sun energy splattered like blood and flesh. Kragos tried to regenerate his body, but Kelliark was already holding what could be called Kragos's core in both hands.
"It's beating like the heart of a living human. The egos of the Sun God are fundamentally not annihilated? Did you believe such nonsense and approach me so foolishly?"
Phwaaaak-!

A squelching, dull sound arose as Kelliark squeezed the core. Kragos's eyes, on his half-remaining head, rolled back and turned white, and his scattered flesh stopped regenerating and twitched in the air.
"A byproduct of a failed god, and not even a special one among them, dares to lay a hand on my body. It is unpleasant, very."
Kelliark said, throwing the remnant of Kragos's core in his hand to the ground.
He wasn't dead. But Kragos was aghast, having barely restored his human form. If not for Malugia's cover in the next moment, he would not have escaped annihilation.

"The only ones who can survive here are Malugia and Jin Runcandel. The rest of you will all die before the Origin Stone arrives. Solderet's legacy? You don't seriously think you can endure for seventeen hours and obtain it, do you?"

Light Origin and Dark Origin magic was spreading out in a radial pattern. A net so wide and dense that even the Genesis Knights couldn't possibly dodge it all was spread out, and blood burst from the mouths and noses of Valeria and Enya.
"Ugh!"
Too much distortion was beginning for the two of them to handle.
But they could not retreat. If they took a step back to avoid the magic, there were their allies, barely hovering on the line between life and death.

"Can't you bear to use them as shields? Well, it's not a bad choice in the end. It wouldn't have meant anything even if you did. But how amusing. Even I don't shy away from any means to an end. Why are you all so complacent?"
As his words suggested, Kelliark was a person who would do anything to realize his desires. Killing enemies, killing allies.

Even now, his widely spread magic was crashing into everything it touched like a wave. It was swallowing not only the Coalition members trying to get into Lafrarosa's shield but also the Demon Army's Genesis Knights and gods who were attacking them.
[Shut up! What do you know!]
It was Orgal.
To him, Kelliark was an eternally repeating nightmare. A wall of despair he had never overcome, a fatal wound that constantly festered.

He had lost everything fighting against him. He had lost countless comrades, lost the precious memories he had with them, and all that was left was only pain, a pain that had continued across hundreds of dimensions until now.

[You demon bastard! You have nothing but desire. Nothing precious, nothing meaningful, nothing to protect. And you want to become the one true god? By destroying this last remaining place? Even if we fall, the universe will stop you. The world will not let you be!]
Orgal swung his sword with his withered arm and blocked Kelliark's path.
The limit to which he could reverse his lifespan had already passed earlier. He simply wanted to take his memories with him, even if he died.
The memory that something remained from that long struggle and resistance, from hundreds of dimensions to this 677th dimension now.

Without a doubt, it was the people. The people fighting together in this place right now, the people who had pointed their swords at each other until a little while ago when they didn't know the truth. That was the final glory Orgal had obtained.
"It's a pity to just kill you. That's why I deliberately left you with a little bit of lifespan, Orgal."

Kelliark created a gust of wind as if he wasn't worth dealing with and pushed him away. Orgal had thrown his entire body to block the Light Origin magic alone, but the fact that he hadn't aged to death was actually because Kelliark had controlled it.
[Yes, I expected as much. That you wouldn't use more of the Light Origin's power, just to mock me. So, do you feel a sense of pleasure?]
"Of course not."

[That is why only the void awaits you. But I am happy, Kelliark Zipfel. If I fall in battle, I will become a soldier of the abyss as always, and the people will remember me. Even if I cannot remember them.]
"After today, the only one who will remember you will be me."
[How many times are you going to say something so stupid... The future you've set has no value.]
Orgal said that and smiled broadly.
And at that moment, behind the flying fortress Lafrarosa, a golden dimensional gate was opening. It was not a gate opened by Kelliark.
